channel.title: Pier & Point · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens (Mission Bay), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: The status line 'since about…
item.description: The status line 'since about Aug 2018' came from an SF Chronicle piece that said Parklab Gardens was 'opening Friday', a report written before the opening. An opening needs a source written after it. The line now rests on Hoodline's report, published August 20, 2018, that Stagecoach Greens, which OCII's November 2024 legend places on P15, 'is now open'. The month stays approximate because that report gives no opening day. No source written after the opening was found for Parklab Gardens, so it has no opening date here. Source: Hoodline, "Now open in Mission Bay: SF's first outdoor mini-golf course" (Aug 20, 2018, https://hoodline.com/2018/08/now-open-in-mission-bay-sf-s-first-outdoor-mini-golf-course/): "San Francisco’s first outdoor mini-golf course, Stagecoach Greens, is now open at 1379 4th St. in Mission Bay."; OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: The 2026-09-24 retail row…
item.description: The 2026-09-24 retail row 'SPARK Social SF operates at 601 Mission Bay Blvd North' was filed on this record when it covered all three west Commons parcels. OCII's November 2024 legend puts SPARK Social SF on P13 ("P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF"), so the tenant is now listed on the P13 record, and the entry on this page is not about a P15 tenant. Another page of the same deck (PDF p.31) groups "P13 & P15: Food Truck Park with Outdoor Dining (SPARK Social SF & Parklab Gardens)"; this page follows the legend. Source: OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: On the Mission Bay Commons…
item.description: On the Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens timeline, the expected late-2028 construction start and the expected early-2030 opening used to appear twice, from two tables with different wording; each now appears once. The entry that stays sets the status to complete, as the removed one did. "Early 2030" names no month, so its date stays 2030 (year only), and the map now shows the park as complete from the end of 2030, not from February 2030. No other dates or statuses changed and no source was dropped. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: The one record for the three…
item.description: The one record for the three west Commons parcels is now three, one per parcel, each named for its parcel and the uses OCII's November 2024 update lists on it. This record keeps its address history and now covers parcel P15 (Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens) only, between 4th St and 3rd St. Its shape was the whole Parklab park strip from OpenStreetMap; it is now that strip's P15 part, cut at 4th St along DataSF's street centerline plus 6.8 m, and is marked approximate because the parcel lines are drawn from OCII's drawing, not surveyed. P15 has no Assessor lot of its own. The old page address redirects here, and the old names still find it in search. Source: OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P12 SFF Soccer + Fitness Court", "P13 Community Garden & SPARK Social SF", "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: Rec and Park's Mission Bay…
item.description: Rec and Park's Mission Bay Future Parks page calls the three parcels "Mission Bay Commons: Parcels P12, P13, and P15", and OCII's November 2024 update titles a slide "Mission Bay Commons Parks (P12, P13, P15)". The new name follows them and stays different from the Mission Bay Commons record. That the parcels hold interim uses today, and are to be rebuilt, is in the record's text. Shape, status and use are unchanged; the old page address redirects to the new one, and the old name still finds the record in search. Source: San Francisco Recreation and Parks, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project): "Mission Bay Commons: Parcels P12, P13, and P15"; OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), slide 1: "Mission Bay Commons Parks (P12, P13, P15)".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: Rec and Park's project page…
item.description: Rec and Park's project page gives estimated construction from late 2028 and opening in early 2030, but also says the remaining parks are anticipated to be complete by 2028; OCII's November 2024 timeline shows construction from mid-2027 through 2028. All are expected dates. In August 2025 Rec and Park said a design team "should be selected by mid-October" (expected); no source read says whether one was selected. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project; https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf.

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: Parklab Gardens and the…
item.description: Parklab Gardens and the Commons interim area: all future dates are expected dates and they differ by source. Rec & Park's page gives construction beginning late 2028 and opening early 2030, yet says the remaining parks 'are anticipated to be complete by 2028'; OCII shows a transfer to Rec and Park 'end of 2028, upon completion'; Rec & Park's April 2025 deck shows construction 'mid-2027 thru 2028'. Parklab Gardens' opening is known only from an August 17, 2018 Chronicle article that says it was 'opening Friday', and OCII's November 2024 slides place it on P15 in one slide and on P13 and P15 in another. Source: SF Rec & Park, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project); OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf); SF Chronicle, Aug 17, 2018, as republished (https://stagecoachgreens.com/cms/outdoor-mini-golf-right-here-in-sf-yes-and-with-food-trucks-and-a-beer-garden/).

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: The map notes said the shape…
item.description: The map notes said the shape traces only the Parklab Gardens sub-area; it is OpenStreetMap's whole 'Parklab' park strip (about 14,665 sq m), which contains both the Parklab Gardens and Spark Social SF areas, and it is tagged as a park, not a garden. The notes also said P15's concept matches Spark Social SF's use of that parcel; OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update puts Spark Social SF and the community garden on P13 and Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens on P15, and the Workshop 3 deck dates interim-use pilots to P13 (2016), P15 (2017) and P12 (2018). The claim that a design team was selected through an August 2025 RFQ now says what SF Rec & Park reports: an RFQ was released and a team was expected by mid-October. The 'early 2030' opening milestone is relabelled as a whole-project estimate, with a note that Workshop 3 shows an earlier construction window. The map notes carry a dated correction, and the shape's notes and source description were corrected. Source: OpenStreetMap way 446183018 (https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/446183018); OCII, Remaining Mission Bay Open Space Parcels Update, Mission Bay CAC, 2024-11-14 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf); SF Rec & Park, Mission Bay Future Parks Project (https://sfrecpark.org/1832/Mission-Bay-Future-Parks-Project); SF Rec & Park, Workshop 3 presentation, 2025-04-29 (https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25986/20250429-PRESENTATION-Workshop-3).

item.title: Added · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: SF Rec & Park's three…
item.description: SF Rec & Park's three community-workshop decks were added as sources for the interim parcels P12, P13 and P15 (OCII's Nov 2024 CAC update labels P13 as Community Garden & SPARK Social SF, P15 as Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens and P12 as the SFF Soccer + Fitness Court), each checked against the PDF itself. Community Meeting #3 (Apr 29, 2025, 83 pages) has individually labeled concept-plan pages for P12, P13 and P15 (food trucks, outdoor dining and a pavilion on P15; soccer pitches and outdoor fitness on P12), plus an alternative option for P12. These are design-workshop concepts, not an adopted final plan: SF Rec & Park's Future Parks page later reported (August 2025) that a design-team RFQ had been released and a team was expected to be selected by mid-October; no selection is reported there. Source: https://sfrecpark.org/DocumentCenter/View/25986/20250429-PRESENTATION-Workshop-3.

Source: San Francisco Recreation and Park Department.

item.title: Existing · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: Stagecoach Greens mini golf… (~Aug 2018)
item.description: Stagecoach Greens mini golf, one of the two uses OCII's November 2024 legend labels on P15 (with Parklab Gardens), is reported open: Hoodline, published August 20, 2018, says "San Francisco's first outdoor mini-golf course, Stagecoach Greens, is now open at 1379 4th St. in Mission Bay". The month is approximate because the report does not give the opening day, and no source written after the opening was found for Parklab Gardens' own opening, so this date is Stagecoach Greens' only. (~Aug 2018). Source: Hoodline, "Now open in Mission Bay: SF's first outdoor mini-golf course" (Kathleen Ngo, published Aug 20, 2018; https://hoodline.com/2018/08/now-open-in-mission-bay-sf-s-first-outdoor-mini-golf-course/); OCII Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024, PDF p.17 legend (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf).
